name: Kc9h9d leave-one-board-out (secondary, diagnostic only)

metrics: aggregates (BTN / SB / BB node frequencies) difference
seat EV difference (raw EV and seat-swap dEV of sigma_lobo into Gext)
5-node class regret excess of sigma_lobo in Gext
argmax switch count and reach share per node
interpretation: practical sensitivity: the effect of the whole board is expected to dominate the effect of its solver residual; this is NOT a rigorous bound on the residual. Primary results (board included) and the panel are not changed whatever the outcome; no automatic top-up.
